data.long_meaning: The name Costel is derived from the Latin word 'costus', meaning 'expense' or 'value'. In the Roman culture, this name was given to children born during times of great cost or expense. The name carries a strong sense of valuation and worth. The name Costel carries the meaning “Cost: Expense, Value” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Costel usually hope their child will grow to embody cost: expense, value and live with faith, good character and purpose.
